topics.title: Larry King’s Marriage & Turkey Hunting
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, callers discuss Larry King’s recent marriage, expressing skepticism about his stability given past divorces. They analyze reader responses criticizing his character and suggest he prioritize his son's well-being if he were to marry again; the conversation then shifts to celebrity charity events including Regis Philbin attending a March of Dimes benefit followed by commentary on Tom’s personal life specifically his turkey hunting hobby.

topics.title: Gary's Breath and Berlin Wall Criticism
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss Gary’s exceptionally bad breath, speculating about his dating life. They then criticize PLJ management over their handling of the Berlin Wall giveaway, highlighting poor decision-making and declining ratings, while also debating Eddie Murphy’s film and Ernie's confusing military service history.

topics.title: Radio Host’s Frustrations and Musical Mishaps
topics.summary: During the broadcast, the host expresses frustration over Eddie Murphy’s language use and debates family values before transitioning to a loud segment featuring Caribbean steel drums alongside news reports. He discusses his housekeeper's musical tastes, a bizarre phone answering machine message from a friend obsessed with a Hollywood movie deal, tangents about Mexicans, and ultimately reveals plans for a film project.

topics.title: Spanky McFarland Discusses Childhood and Finances
topics.summary: During a radio interview, Spanky from ‘Little Rascals’ recounts his childhood filming experiences, revealing low pay and chaotic on-set behavior including potential antics with Mrs. Crabtree while admitting to occasional overwhelm. He discusses his wife's romantic nature, her reluctance to share money, and concerns about future financial control by others, particularly a telephone salesman.

topics.title: RKL Guy’s Strange Questions and Stern’s Reactions
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern interacts with an RKL guy who asks bizarre questions about ‘young rascals,’ leading to speculation he might be mentally unstable. Ernie attempts to smooth the conversation while new interviews reveal previous interactions involving a deceased dog named Snuggles and ongoing publicity challenges.

topics.title: Weather Forecast and Phone Call Chaos
topics.summary: The broadcast begins with a detailed weather forecast predicting thickening clouds, rain, and potential showers throughout the week. A chaotic phone call segment follows featuring Howard Stern discussing Ed Koch’s political aspirations and Deakins' transition team, culminating in a bizarre interaction involving a confused caller claiming to be possessed.
